drafts.text:
If your Search Console impressions dropped around Sept 21, don't panic yet.

Lily Ray spotted queries with huge impressions and almost zero clicks that just stopped. She's asking if it's tied to Google's anti-scraping moves.

Check clicks and calls first. Those are customers.
drafts.video_tip: Video tip: 15-second screen record of your own Search Console (StableAFdesigns or a site you have access to). Open Performance, show the clicks line next to impressions, pause on clicks. Caption: 'Impressions aren't customers. Watch clicks and calls.' Use whatever your real numbers show that day. No invented results.
drafts.best_time_ct: Weekday late morning CT; the standing 8:54 AM slot works for one a day.

drafts.text:
Never plug a generator into a dryer outlet to power the house.

That's called backfeeding. It can send power out on the lines, right to a lineworker.

A transfer switch or interlock, installed by a licensed electrician, keeps it safe.

SoLit Electric, Baton Rouge. 225-472-1165

Thinking about a Level 2 EV charger at home?

The first question isn't which charger. It's whether your panel has room for the load.

Have a licensed electrician check before anything gets installed.

SoLit Electric, Baton Rouge. Panels and EV chargers.
225-472-1165
